function.description: Ask the local decision model ONE typed question about a piece of state and get probability-shaped scores back (NOT calibrated probabilities of being right; no free text is generated). Types: noul (yes/no), choice (pick one named option), score (ordinal 0..N-1). Use it for gating and routing decisions; answers carry a confidence (a shaping convention), and min_confidence withholds an answer that is not confident enough. An answer with flags ["option_missing"] had an option absent from the model's readout: its upper_bounds say how likely that option could still be, and it is only as confident as that bound allows. The decision model is not a chat model.
function.name: decide

min_confidence.description: tool-level, not sent to the gateway: when any answer's confidence is lower (a flagged answer is capped at 1 - its largest upper bound) the answer is withheld and the call is reported as an error (fail closed)

model.description: decision profile id; omit for the gateway default

criteria.description: noul: optional {"true":text,"false":text}; choice: {"option":description,...} with 2..255 options (a gateway may allow fewer, default 20); score: array of 2..10 level descriptions

instructions.description: the question to answer about the state

type.description: noul: yes/no; choice: one of the named options; score: ordinal level

questions.description: question name -> typed question; the names key the answers

state.description: what the question is about: text, or any JSON object or array (delimited and neutralised as data - best effort, not a guarantee)
